title: A Structure-Preserving Semi-Lagrangian based bi-fidelity method for the Vlasov--Poisson system with uncertainties
summary: Uncertainty quantification for the Vlasov--Poisson (VP) systems entails repeated dynamic simulations, incurring immense computational costs. We develop a structure-preserving Semi-Lagrangian (SL) b-fidelity approximation of macroscopic observables. The MUSCL is used as a low-fidelity solver for pressureless Euler--Poisson system, allowing for a more cost-effective exploration of the stochastic parameter space.
